faqs.q: What is the total cost, beyond the course fee?
faqs.a: We do not publish fees on the website. Your counsellor will share the complete cost sheet, tuition, registration, documents, uniform, accommodation, food, examination and travel where applicable, in writing during your free counselling call, before you enrol.

faqs.q: Is life onboard safe, and is it suitable for girls?
faqs.a: Ships are structured, supervised workplaces with clear routines and support onboard. During counselling we discuss daily life, safety and what to expect, so you and your family can decide with full information.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Cruise Line and Merchant Navy careers?
faqs.a: Cruise line careers are guest service and hospitality roles aboard passenger ships. Merchant Navy careers are technical and deck roles aboard commercial ships. Both can lead to global work, the right fit depends on your aptitude and goals, which is what the counselling call is for.

about.title: Shaping global careers with structured training and family first guidance.
about.intro: National Global Academy is a training and career guidance institute in Noida. We help students after Class 10 and Class 12 understand cruise, Merchant Navy, aviation and hospitality pathways before they commit. Every counselling call includes parents, and every course is explained in writing.
about.vision: A future where every student from a small town can build a respected global career at sea, in the air and across hospitality, with the knowledge and confidence to choose well.
about.mission: Each day we guide students and their families through honest counselling, structured training and clear steps from first enquiry to seat confirmation.

contactFaqs.q: Can I visit the academy before applying?
contactFaqs.a: Yes, visits are by appointment so an advisor and the relevant faculty member can make time for your questions. Visiting hours are Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Book through the counselling form or on WhatsApp.

contactFaqs.q: Can the counselling call include my parents?
contactFaqs.a: Yes, parents are welcome on every counselling call and at every step. We discuss course options and documents with the family, not just the student.

contactFaqs.q: What should I bring to counselling?
contactFaqs.a: Just your latest qualification details and your questions. If you already have documents like mark sheets or an ID, keep them handy, your counsellor will tell you exactly what is needed next.
Within one working day of your enquiry. If you message on WhatsApp, you will usually hear back the same day.
